backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no state or methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping deployment-related features to affected files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for multiple frontend source files used in the Chocolate Day app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Detailed guide explaining deployment, retry flow, troubleshooting, and post‑deployment checks for the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining color palettes, dark mode overrides, and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/PRODUCTION_URL.txt: Template file meant to store the production URL and last update timestamp after deployment.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App root that renders the ChocolateDayPage component.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/ch: Defines a Chocolate interface and exports a list containing one favorite chocolate entry.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/Ch: Main 6‑step flow page managing step state, navigation, and rendering all step components.
Centered gallery showing selectable chocolates with a reveal button and favorite badge.
Dialog that displays a selected chocolate’s image and romantic message with confetti and close controls.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/Fl: Renders back/next buttons for step navigation with disabled states for first and last steps.
Displays current step out of total and shows progress dots with active and completed states.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/He: Generates floating animated heart particles unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/st: Shows a grid of chocolates with associated meanings using styled cards and animations.
Renders an Instagram‑style story card featuring themed text and chocolate imagery.
Displays a heartfelt message with decorative hearts and styled containers.
Shows another multi‑paragraph compliment message with animated heart icons.
Implements a revealable virtual gift box that switches from a closed image to an open chocolate display with messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on authentication identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context/provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and Identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, a custom OKLCH color theme for light/dark modes, global styles, and several animation keyframes and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, extended theme settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes project scope, feature set, known issues, and recent updates for expanding a romantic multi‑page Chocolate Day experience.
